sources.title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite
sources.authorPublisher: Cold Iron Studios / official Aliens: Fireteam Elite site
sources.contribution: Official overview of the launch-era game roster, cooperative context and classes. Counts are not a complete current expansion roster.
sources.limitations: No per-enemy choreography, frame counts, full DLC archive, or costume-specific film authenticity.

sources.title: RELEASE NOTES | Aliens Fireteam Elite
sources.authorPublisher: Cold Iron Studios / official release notes
sources.contribution: Official acknowledgement of a grapple mechanic and implementation corrections. Prowler stumble behavior is also present in text.
sources.limitations: Does not give a full Prowler animation cycle, victim pin geometry, frame timing or per-species choreography.

sources.title: Pathogen Deep Dive: An Exhilarating New Story | Aliens Fireteam Elite
sources.authorPublisher: Cold Iron Studios; statements credited to Craig Zinkievich, Matt Highison and Chris Matz
sources.contribution: Named Brute ground impact/shockwaves and Queen clustered acid shots; descriptions of Pathogen Runner, Blight and the campaign are present. The same article classifies4C2 Astra as Rifle/Auto Rifle and describes repeating3-round bursts; this does not imply a current catalogue bug.
sources.limitations: No measured startup, active/recovery timing, projectile count or canonical2D choreography. Existing arena tuning remains simulation.

sources.title: Crossplay, A New Game Mode, New Progression System & More Coming July 26th! | Aliens Fireteam Elite
sources.authorPublisher: Cold Iron Studios / official Season4 announcement
sources.contribution: Official cosmetic reward categories and named Season4 weapons; supports separating FTE cosmetics from1986 film costumes. The page names APEsuit Mk.3 and Seegson Maintenance overalls and the four listed Season4 weapons; names alone do not verify every visual detail.
sources.limitations: Does not identify every outfit in the project, prove a film-exact costume or provide a modular game sprite atlas.

sources.title: ArtStation - Guardian Version.02
sources.authorPublisher: Raymond Sebastien, credited by the project OpenGraph author/title
sources.evidenceScope: production concept identity / creator lore commentary
sources.contribution: Creator-authored Guardian Version.02 concept identity; description names Marlow, Darwin Era and Embryostatis. This is separate from the Fanatics/Androids/Commando project.
sources.locator: meta description / og:title Guardian Version.02, Raymond Sebastien
sources.limitations: Creator concept and final-design wording do not establish the final animated game model, attack timing, physical size or permission to reuse artwork. Full visual assets not certified by HTML metadata.

sources.title: ArtStation - Ennemies for Aliens dark descent : The Fanatics, Androids, Weyland yutani Commando
sources.authorPublisher: Raymond Sebastien, credited by the project OpenGraph author/title
sources.contribution: Creator project covers a selection of Fanatics concepts and names Androids/Weyland-Yutani Commando in its title. It cannot be silently substituted for Guardian Version.02.
sources.locator: meta description / og:title Fanatics, Androids, Weyland yutani Commando
sources.limitations: No specific concept sheet was visually re-reviewed through the HTML metadata alone; it does not automatically certify each roster row or final animation.

sources.title: Tindalos Interactive Aliens: Dark Descent Art Blast - ArtStation Magazine
sources.authorPublisher: Daniel Wade / ArtStation Magazine; showcase credits Tindalos Interactive artists
sources.contribution: Production showcase independently credits Raymond Sebastien as a character concept artist for Aliens: Dark Descent.
sources.limitations: Showcase credit is not a frame-level animation reference, a complete final model roster, a measured size chart or a reuse licence.

sources.title: Aliens: Dark Descent - Focus Entertainment Facebook Twitter Instagram Facebook Twitter Youtube Twitch Instagram
sources.authorPublisher: Focus Entertainment / Tindalos Interactive /20th Century Studios
sources.contribution: Publisher-hosted game identity and developer/publisher credits.
sources.limitations: The retrieved server-rendered page contains limited descriptive text. No custom Blackout/Earth DLC archive or complete faction animation corpus is supplied.

sources.title: Alien: Isolation™ - The Collection - manual
sources.authorPublisher: Feral Interactive; original game by Creative Assembly / SEGA
sources.contribution: Official Isolation manual documents corridors/ducts, crouching, concealment and noise mechanics in that game.
sources.limitations: This is Alien: Isolation, not Alien: Blackout. It does not recover the missing user-provided Blackout/Earth DLC archives or establish their contents.

sources.title: Aliens | 20th Century Studios
sources.evidenceScope: film identity / cast credit / published image metadata
sources.contribution: Official film identity, release date and cast credit list. The page also names a loader/Queen hero image in its alt text.
sources.limitations: The cast list does not map each actor to a role in the retrieved text and does not certify each Hicks/Hudson/Vasquez modular piece. Remote image/video frames were not inferred from alt text.

sources.title: Characters - Raymond SEBASTIEN Character Concept Artist
sources.contribution: Current artist portfolio navigation and attribution are accessible; a Marlow entry is present. Historical/projects/g0Va4P andJvgEP0 URLs remain404.
sources.limitations: Current portfolio page does not itself replace the missing historical concept pages or supply a complete Dark Descent model/animation archive.

sources.title: Guardian Version.02 — public project metadata
sources.evidenceScope: creator project identity / exact asset index / captioned concept-versus-in-game-still distinction
sources.contribution: Public project metadata identifies a Guardian final-model sheet and a separate in-game Guardian still credited to Tamás Kerti; it also lists attitude/scene concept art.
sources.limitations: The four ArtStation CDN image requests are still CONNECT403. Captions were read, but their image pixels were not viewed or certified and no motion cycle/timecode follows from them.

sources.title: Fanatics, Androids, Weyland yutani Commando — public project metadata
sources.evidenceScope: creator concept taxonomy / rejected-versus-final identity distinction
sources.contribution: The public asset index distinguishes rejected GuardianV01 research, Fanatics sketches, Weyland-Yutani Commando concept and AndroidDaniel head/body concepts. It must not be collapsed into GuardianV02.
sources.limitations: Asset65092845 is explicitly a failed first Guardian version. CDN images remain unavailable; neither this index nor a title certifies a final animated Android/Commando game model.

sources.title: Official Pathogen Queen reconnaissance reference image
sources.evidenceScope: official static image identity / silhouette reference / approximate diegetic size
sources.contribution: The actually viewed official sheet names PATHOGENQUEEN, shows a heavy external carapace and describes approximate4.25m height in its diegetic reconnaissance panel. The stated stance is hunched; this applies only to that variant.
sources.locator: Image embedded after PathogenQueen paragraph;1920x1080 image directly viewed through view_image
sources.limitations: The approximate in-universe reconnaissance note is not a precise physical measurement, orthographic model, collision specification or animation. It must not set arena balance or other Queen variants by inference.

sources.title: Official Pathogen weapon reference grid
sources.evidenceScope: official weapon identity / static silhouette comparison
sources.contribution: All four printed weapon names and distinct still silhouettes are actually readable in the downloaded official image. These correspond to project IDs160,161,172,173.
sources.locator: Official article weapon grid;1920x1080 image directly viewed through view_image
sources.limitations: This image does not establish dimensions, grip/muzzle pivots, reload animation, rates, ammunition, full material accuracy or1:1 generated sprites.
